_readme: Functions exported from functions/src but intentionally NOT deployed. Each entry needs name, reason and addedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). check-deploy-drift.mjs fails on a malformed entry, one older than 60 days, a name that is no longer exported, or a name that is now deployed. See scripts/lib/driftAllowlist.mjs.

functionsNotDeployed.name: resolveCommunityInvite
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Public, unauthenticated invite resolver. Deploys with the web landing task (waiting on the real domain); nothing in the app calls it. Its IP rate key is unverified until deployed.

functionsNotDeployed.name: callClaude
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Hardened (task registry, per-uid burst+daily quotas) but UNDEPLOYED on purpose: the three hooks that call it (useGenerateTitle, useAiCrewSuggestion, useAiCrewRecommendation) are exported from src/features/crew/hooks and imported by NOTHING, so no screen invokes it. An authenticated endpoint spending the platform's Anthropic key with zero legitimate callers is liability without upside. Deploy it in the same change that ships the UI.

functionsNotDeployed.name: createCommunityInvite
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Community-invite backend. Deploys with the web landing task, alongside resolveCommunityInvite. Nothing in src/ calls it: the deep-link intake exists (deepLinks/allowlist.ts matches /c/{token}, pendingIntentStore holds a requestJoin intent) but no screen creates, resolves or revokes an invite yet, so deploying would add a live endpoint for an unshipped feature. The firestore.rules joinRequests guard fails closed meanwhile: hasValidInviteOrigin requires exists(communityInvites/{token}), and with no creator deployed no token exists, so a via:'invite' request is always denied.
